chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Al-Fadl ibn Shazan, all together, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hisham ibn Al-Hakam, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
From the happiness is the spaciousness of the home.
ai.seo_question: What does Shia hadith say about the relationship between home size and happiness?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links physical comfort to spiritual and social well-being, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the material conditions that facilitate worship and family life. This narration underscores that a spacious home is not merely a luxury but a means of preserving dignity and fostering a conducive environment for moral and religious development.
